# getliyo

> A free web tool to download publicly available Instagram videos, photos, Reels, Stories and IGTV (also other sites). No sign-up; prepared files are deleted within 15 minutes. Languages: Türkçe, English, العربية.

## Pages
- [English]({{SITE_URL}}/en/): paste a link and download
- [Türkçe]({{SITE_URL}}/tr/): bağlantıyı yapıştır ve indir
- [العربية]({{SITE_URL}}/ar/): الصق الرابط وحمّل
- [Terms of Use]({{SITE_URL}}/en/terms), [Privacy]({{SITE_URL}}/en/privacy), [Copyright / DMCA]({{SITE_URL}}/en/copyright), [Cookies]({{SITE_URL}}/en/cookies), [Contact]({{SITE_URL}}/en/contact)
